candidates.title: Chess Olympiad 2026 countdown marked in Hyderabad with ceremonial torch handover
candidates.excerpt: The official countdown to the Chess Olympiad 2026 was marked in Hyderabad with the ceremonial torch being handed over to Uzbek star Javokhir Sindarov by FIDE Interim President Viswanathan Anand and AICF president Nitin Narang ahead of the Samarkand event.

candidates.excerpt: Justice Samuel Alito, joined by fellow conservative Justice Clarence Thomas, dissented from the decision, comparing some ‌of the challengers’ claims to a “Hail Mary pass” that is “unlikely to be successfully completed,” using a football analogy

candidates.title: Iran’s IRGC says oil tanker explodes after hitting naval mines in Hormuz Strait
candidates.excerpt: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps said an oil tanker identified as EL GAIA exploded and caught fire after hitting naval mines while attempting to cross the Strait of Hormuz through a forbidden route, as Tehran maintained that the waterway remains closed.

candidates.title: U.S. lawmaker submits amendment naming India in Russia sanctions act
candidates.excerpt: The Lindsey O Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act, passed by the U.S. Senate by an overwhelming 86-11 vote last month, seeks to impose sanctions not only on Russia's leadership and energy sector but also on the "shadow fleet" of vessels that enable Moscow to evade sanctions on oil deliveries.

candidates.title: Former DUTA chief Aditya Narayan Mishra joins Congress, flags ‘crisis’ in education
candidates.excerpt: Mr. Mishra joined the party in the presence of Delhi Congress in-charge Qazi Nizamuddin, Delhi Pradesh Congress Committee president Devender Yadav, AICC Uttar Pradesh in-charge Rajendra Pal Gautam and other party leaders

candidates.title: Intensify protest over land acquisition: Rakesh Tikait urges Noida farmers
candidates.excerpt: The Bharatiya Kisan Union (BKU) national spokesperson alleged that the administration was preventing farmers from holding protests and meeting officials; farmers have been seeking developed residential plots and enhanced compensation for land acquired for development projects

candidates.title: Police arrest BRS leaders over turmeric water protest near KCR’s residence
candidates.excerpt: Seven BRS leaders from Varadarajpur were arrested for allegedly spraying turmeric water on Congress leaders heading to K. Chandrashekhar Rao’s residence. A court remanded them to 15 days in judicial custody following a police investigation.

candidates.title: U.P. Congress seeks one-time relief for State teacher recruitment exam candidates over new eligibility rules
candidates.excerpt: U.P. Congress chief Ajay Rai writes to CM Yogi Adityanath based on a representation of demands received from Trained Graduate Teachers (TGT), Post Graduate Teachers (PGT) 2026 candidates

candidates.title: Drone shot down by NATO over Lithuania
candidates.excerpt: Baltic states Lithuania, Latvia and Estonia — NATO members sharing a long border with Russia — regularly report drone incursions into their territories as part of Moscow's war with Ukraine.

candidates.title: Bamboo mass flowering and die-off can trigger ecological crisis and wildlife conflict, study warns
candidates.excerpt: Synchronous flowering and die-off can open the door to invasive weeds, fuel wildfires, trigger rodent surges and push elephants into farmland, says Kerala Forest Research Institute study

candidates.title: What are the AI threats flagged by Anthropic? | Explained
candidates.excerpt: Anthropic released information about several malicious activities detected and disrupted between December 2025 and August 2026, which had serious implications across seven key areas: scams and fraud, cyber operations, illicit distillation, influence operations, surveillance operations, conventional weapons and biological misuse
